sentence_transformers.rationale: Heavyweight in-process HuggingFace/PyTorch models are intentionally excluded from services/ml to eliminate cold-start lag, excessive RAM/VRAM consumption, and CUDA runtime drift. Embeddings are delegated via HttpEmbeddingClient to external embedding servers (TEI/OpenAI/bge-m3), and reranking is handled via EvidenceReranker (cosine scoring) and LLM task contracts (rag_reranking).

faster_whisper.rationale: faster-whisper is not a direct dependency of services/ml. It is isolated in the services/asr sidecar container to protect the core ML service from native CTranslate2 and PyAV binary dependencies. Scribe calls ASR over HTTP/OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions.

services_ocr.architecture: Lightweight Vision bridge via Router Gateway (gemini-3.7-flash-tiered / gemini-3.6-flash-high) with Google Cloud Vision fallback.

services_asr.architecture: Local Whisper sidecar running faster-whisper with CTranslate2 CPU int8 quantization and PyAV audio decoding.

interface_assumptions: apps/web strictly runs and builds against Node 20.x with npm 10.x, verified via package-lock.json v3.
services/ml maintains a zero-in-process-PyTorch invariant: dense embeddings and heavy neural passes are strictly handled through HTTP endpoints or external microservices.
PostgreSQL pgvector extension provides production dense vector search, with automatic fallback to InMemoryRetriever if pgvector is absent.
services/asr runs as an isolated sidecar container on port 8090, serving OpenAI-compatible audio transcription for Scribe consultations.
services/ocr operates on port 8080 as a thin Gemini Vision proxy, receiving prescription/lab document images and returning structured drug entities.
